node.title: L1 official broad-checkpoint Frobenius periodicity exclusion
node.statement: For a minimum-width split-fiber pair on an official multiplicative coset, the balanced {0,+1,-1} exponent word over F_p has Fourier zeros at exponents 0,...,p-1. Frobenius closes this zero set under multiplication by p modulo n. On each of the seven exact m>=3 atlas rows with remainder n-mp>16, every residual frequency is divisible by a printed even gcd in {2,4,8}. Fourier inversion then makes each sign support periodic with even orbit size, contradicting its odd size p. Thus all seven broad rows have empty t=p first-checkpoint strata at every depth. Only nine rows n=m(p+1), m in {4,8,16}, retain a higher-multiplicity minimum-width endpoint.
